title: Slurm Config Util Configuration Schema
description: Schema for slurm_config_util_config.yml - Slurm configuration utility configuration

storage_config_path.description: Path to storage_config.yml (contains NFS mount definitions)

pxe_mapping_path.description: Path to the PXE/node mapping file

slurm_share_dir_name.description: NFS share directory name for Slurm

slurm_backups_dir_name.description: NFS share directory name for Slurm backups

nfs_storage_name.description: Specific NFS storage name to use

rollback_backup_list_limit.description: Maximum number of backups shown during rollback selection
